page.overview:
Who is Sevastus Acheran?

Sevastus Acheran was a Primaris Space Marine and former captain of the Ultramarines Chapter's 2nd Company and Master of the Watch. Acheran originally served under the command of the 2nd Company's long-time commander, Captain Cato Sicarius.

But Sicarius was lost in the Warp with the birth of the Great Rift while returning to Macragge from Terra with Fleet Avenger. Sicarius had accompanied Roboute Guilliman to see the Emperor during the Terran Crusade and was now returning with the gift of the first Primaris Space Marines to the Ultramarines, which reached the Chapter even as Sicarius was lost. With Sicarius missing, Acheran was assigned to serve as his replacement.

Like many Adeptus Astartes captains, Sevastus Acheran originally served as a company officer under his predecessor, but was not with Cato Sicarius when his fateful voyage to return to Macragge in the wake of the Terran Crusade was swallowed up by the thrashing of the Great Rift. Acheran, appointed as Sicarius' replacement, led the 2nd Company through many of the defining conflicts of the early Indomitus Crusade, seeing action on Vigilus during the War of Beasts, within the Pariah Nexus, in Ultramar during the Plague Wars, and in the Fourth Tyrannic War in the Segmentum Tempestus. Most famously, he commanded the company when Lieutenant Demetrian Titus was reclaimed during the Ultramarines' campaign against the Tyranids and Thousand Sons Legion in the Recidious System.

Acheran was heroically slain alongside his entire Ultramarines task force defending the Hive World of Trygg from a Genestealer Cult uprising during the Fourth Tyrannic War at some point after the Recidious Campaign. He was replaced as the commander of the 2nd Company by Demetrian Titus, one of his predecessors in that command, who was newly restored to his old rank of captain and Master of the Watch.
